addition.item: With Icon Pro installed, the icon can be any of Icon Pro's icons (over 2,000 Lucide icons, UIkit icons or an icon font), picked from its gallery in the "Icon (Icon Pro)" field. It takes the alert's icon colour and size.

Placement: in the page, sticking to the top while scrolling (with a top offset for a sticky header), a bar fixed to the bottom of the window (optionally floating off the edges, keeping the end of the page visible above it), or a toast in one of six corners.

Toasts: width, show after a number of seconds and hide after a number of seconds (paused while the pointer or keyboard focus is on them). Several toasts in one corner stack; on phones they take the full width.
The builder preview keeps placed alerts in the page with a label, so they stay editable.

First release: alerts with a title, content, icon (a type's own, any UIkit icon or an image) and up to two buttons. Info, Success, Warning, Danger, Neutral or custom colours; Soft, Solid, Outline, Left border, Top border, Gradient or Glass styles; three sizes, corner radius, shadow, compact one-line layout and buttons beside or below the text.
Close button that hides the alert with a fade or slide, and can remember it for the browser session, a number of days or for good. A changed alert shows again.
Show from and Show until dates in the site's time zone, checked on the server, with an optional "Ends in" countdown that hides the alert when time is up.
A one-time Pulse or Shake to draw attention; screen readers hear Warning and Danger alerts straight away.
